scope: Read-only audit for a source/reference-only SAM completion experiment before any GPU launch or target readout.

prompt_policy.negative_supervision: the raw negative scribble is retained separately when the SAM positive completion trains the relation classifier

published_reference.important_protocol_boundary: The reproduced 0.9125768502741802 result is the released all-view, three-seed LUDVIG protocol. Its SAM uplifting calls read every registered view RGB, including the eventual target RGB, and therefore it is not a strict unseen source-only result.

official_sam3.loader_contract: build_sam3_image_model with enable_segmentation=false and enable_inst_interactivity=true; in reduced precision only the official visual backbone and official interactive decoder are cast and moved to CUDA

official_point_interface.box_prompt_warning: Sam3Processor.add_geometric_prompt is the normalized cxcywh box interface and is not the direct point-prompt API required here.

existing_cache_audit.conclusion: No existing cache can be relabeled as the fern or horns_left signed-scribble source completion; two new source masks must be produced and frozen.

source_binding_conclusion: Both sentinels can be bound without ambiguity: reference RGB and annotation reference RGB are byte-identical; official positive and negative scribbles already match the frozen manifest hashes; the exact W caches bind the same prompt frame, prompt hashes, camera, geometry, intrinsics, and pose at 1008x756.

runtime_preflight.error: CUDA Error 804: forward compatibility was attempted on non supported HW
runtime_preflight.required_before_launch: Use a host driver/runtime combination accepted by this official SAM3 environment, or validate a separate environment that supports the official SAM3 source and checkpoint. Re-run the CUDA availability and one-image point-decoder smoke test before scheduling sentinels.
runtime_preflight.safety_note: This audit does not diagnose by launching CUDA and does not reserve GPU0 or GPU1.

estimated_two_sentinel_cost_after_runtim.assumptions: Reuse the already-frozen exact responsibility and canonical field assets; run one official point-only SAM3 source completion per scene; no field training and no responsibility re-export.
estimated_two_sentinel_cost_after_runtim.sam3_source_completion: approximately 1-3 minutes total including cold model load, conservative estimate
estimated_two_sentinel_cost_after_runtim.exact_adjoint_and_current_support: approximately 5-9 minutes total for both scenes, based on prior exact-cache/support jobs
estimated_two_sentinel_cost_after_runtim.target_scoring: approximately 1 minute total after both method receipts are frozen
estimated_two_sentinel_cost_after_runtim.gpu_memory: point-only BF16 is intended to fit a 24-GB RTX 3090; exact peak has not been measured in the current host state

comparison_to_ludvig_0_91258.model: official SAM3 interactive decoder versus LUDVIG's SAM v1 ViT-H
comparison_to_ludvig_0_91258.rgb_visibility: one frozen source/reference RGB only versus every registered RGB including target during LUDVIG uplifting
comparison_to_ludvig_0_91258.field: current compact canonical capability field plus exact source adjoint/support versus LUDVIG's original all-view 3DGS uplifting
comparison_to_ludvig_0_91258.randomness: one deterministically registered source completion versus LUDVIG's three seeded full-system runs with random point sampling
comparison_to_ludvig_0_91258.negative_scribble: raw negative scribble remains explicit negative unary supervision in both the proposed role-compatible source completion and LUDVIG's DINO relation path
comparison_to_ludvig_0_91258.claim_boundary: The proposed experiment is LUDVIG-role-compatible but neither model-exact nor protocol-exact. Its sentinel score must not be presented as a direct reproduction of 0.9125768502741802.
